scope: Actual six rendered PNG views visually inspected against locally retained official floorplan and historical facade photographs; not engineering, printability, present-condition, or exact-window certification.
observations: All six actual renders were opened and examined before this review record.
Main rectangular footprint ratio agrees with interpreted official 71m by32m column-grid envelope; detailing remains approximate.
Triangular outer pediment and internal curved fanlight match distinctive sourcephoto3 rather than a free-standing semicircular arch.
Five repeated storeys and side-end small apertures are visible; muted brick palette is photo-derived and uncalibrated.
limitations: Whole roof is neutral closed cap only; actual courtyard/roof configuration was not verified and cap is not claimed surveyed roof.
Upper stair projections, mirrored end openings, symmetric repetitive facade grids and rear-central glazing contain explicitly declared inference; no window-by-window fidelity claim.
Historical official photos are low resolution and do not establish2026 appearance.
No minimum-wall/support/slicer/trial-print certification; visual pass does not imply fabrication readiness.
